test_ctc_criterion: test the CTC loss criterion by composing a CTC graph with emissions and computing forward scores
test_asg_criterion: test the ASG loss criterion by composing emissions with transitions and computing forward scores
test_asg_viterbi_path: test the ASG Viterbi path by composing emissions with transitions and extracting the best path labels
create_emissions_graph: create a linear emissions graph from a probability vector with optional log-probability conversion
create_ctc_graph: create a CTC graph from a target sequence and blank label for connectionist temporal classification
